# Kitchen Substitute

> Ingredient substitutions with exact amounts — offline, no ads. Free web guide: US and metric amounts, pantry ranking, function notes, trade-offs, baking-safety flags. 361 of 363 substitutes include a full ratio breakdown (the exceptions give safety guidance instead of numbers). 155 ingredients. The iPhone app ($0.99 once, offline, no ads, no account) also ingests whole recipes by photo, link or pasted text and re-amounts them for allergies and diets.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815952974

## By situation
- [Substitute for buttermilk in pancakes](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/buttermilk-in-pancakes/): 1 Tbsp lemon juice or vinegar + enough milk to reach 1 cup, rest 10 min
- [Substitute for eggs in cookies](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/eggs-in-cookies/): flax egg — 1 Tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 Tbsp water, rest 10 min
- [Substitute for butter in cookies](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/butter-in-cookies/): stick-style plant butter 1:1, or 3/4 cup oil per cup for melted uses
- [Substitute for heavy cream in soup](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/heavy-cream-in-soup/): 3/4 cup milk + 1/4 cup melted butter per cup (will not whip)
- [Substitute for brown sugar in cookies](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/brown-sugar-in-cookies/): 1 cup white sugar + 1 Tbsp molasses per cup (chemically identical)
- [Substitute for milk in baking](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/milk-in-baking/): 1 cup unsweetened soy or oat milk, or 1 cup water + 1 1/2 tsp melted butter
- [Substitute for sour cream in baking](https://normzeng.github.io/kitchen-substitute-content/sour-cream-in-baking/): full-fat Greek yogurt 1:1

Ratios are researched dataset values, not guarantees; the generator copies every amount verbatim from the dataset and never invents copy. Contact: aechopp@gmail.com
